reason: Primary purpose is a DeepSeek Harness Web UI appearance plugin: it provides wallpaper-based theming, opacity controls, color/foundation token customization, auto palette generation, and UI scaling options. It is a user-facing theming/UI customization plugin rather than automation, search, or data-analysis tooling. Risk is moderate because it handles user-provided images and persists/export scheme data (including embedded media) locally, but no network/external execution behavior is indicated.

capabilities: User-configurable wallpaper and UI appearance themes
Theme token and CSS style override injection
Persistent settings stored in browser localStorage
Scheme export/import to JSON (including embedded wallpaper data)

reasons.code: README describes wallpaper upload, local image compression, per-surface opacity, color/theme controls, and settings persistence in localStorage.
README Architecture section states appearance is applied via theme override tokens plus injected body styles with a fixed background layer.
README warns exported JSON contains full wallpaper data, with explicit privacy note about sensitive images before sharing.
package.json shows a browser web client plugin that injects theme/slot modules for host integration.
